blocks.text: IV. PROTOCOL: See Diabetes Mellitus Type I or Type II - Insulin-Treated Protocol
blocks.html: IV. PROTOCOL: See Diabetes Mellitus Type I or Type II - Insulin-Treated Protocol

blocks.text:
- Insulin pumps are an acceptable form of treatment.
- Combinations of anti-diabetes medication (s): The chart of Acceptable Combinations of Diabetes Medications (pdf) summarizes the acceptable medications for both monotherapy and combination therapy. The chart organizes medications into groups based on similarity of mechanisms of actions and/or therapeutic effects.
